rules: This reservation and the exact V46 expert-defer control coordinate must be committed before dev-v42 membership creation or model work.
Membership construction and disjointness verification are primary-agent-only and must not render seed values into agent output.
Dev-v42 must be generated solely within [10000000000,11000000000), disjoint by namespace from every prior governed set without reading their membership.
The committed one-way consumer must atomically create the dev-v42 umbrella attempt before its first manifest read or baseline episode.
A started, aborted, failed, exposed, or completed dev-v42 attempt consumes that set permanently.
No dev-v42 access is authorized until exact replicas, the reusable 25 percent expert-defer cap, and permanent-greedy and matched-greedy scorecards all pass.
Held-out-v6 remains governed by ADR-0053 and cannot be read until dev-v42 passes every frozen gate.
